run_cutler_demo_on_images: run the CutLER demo on input images using a config file and confidence threshold
run_cutler_demo_on_webcam: run the CutLER demo on webcam input with real-time OpenCV visualization
run_cutler_demo_on_video: run the CutLER demo on a video file and optionally save annotated output
setup_cutler_config: setup a Detectron2 config with CutLER options from a YAML file and CLI arguments
test_opencv_video_format: test whether an OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the system
